new_findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite each as two plain sentences: what differs and where (sbl: tag), then the two attribution lines verbatim.

new_findings.claim: Positional, cross-row or process references that §8 and question 3 exclude: W2-015 'The close lies at the part frontier with 8:1, a question left for end review'; W2-003 'disclosed on the unit at 6:9'; W3-004 'in these three chapters'; W5-014 'summarizes the chapter'; W6-005 'that rival is disclosed on the unit that opens at 15:50'.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Replace with span-explicit or content statements (e.g. 'in 1Cor 8:1-11:1', 'the reading that closes 15:35-15:49 is the rival'); drop part/process language.

new_findings.claim: W3-001's confidence is capped because the row 'spans the whole chapter ... chapter-fallback level' (a chapter division shaping a grade); W3-002..W3-004 are medium_low on a unit-type question (example vs defence) rather than seam doubt.
new_findings.evidence: W3-001 boundary_rationale; W3-002..004 boundary_rationale ('Typing as example is held open').
new_findings.suggested_fix: Grade W3-001 on its seam evidence (peri de onset, 8:13/9:1 close) and say so; on W3-002..004 state whether the seam or only the typing is doubtful. Do not raise grades without byte evidence.

new_findings.claim: Run on a slice of the combined file, the validator reports RED for every row of W2-W6 because it expects part-local chunk_index_in_book, while the combine renumbers book-wide. A reviewer must reset indices to get a meaningful result.
new_findings.evidence: val_W2..W6.json RED with only chunk_index problems; val_W<n>_partidx.json all GREEN.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Add a --book-index mode (check monotone and contiguous within the slice) or have the combine keep a part-local index field.

new_findings.claim: Mandated attribution and tier lines create an 8-row 7-gram block in W3 (39 grams); below the default gate but would trip a gate of 7.
new_findings.evidence: ngram7.py --gate 7 --full-ids -> 47 grams, 39 of them in the W3 block.
new_findings.suggested_fix: Exclude the two §8 rule 14 attribution lines (exact strings) from prose before n-gramming.

new_findings.claim: W6 refs carry no WARRANT/DISCLOSURE tags and W5 refs are thin (W5-001 has no WARRANT-close:near ref); the writer validator passed them, so the tag convention is not enforced across parts.
